exact_statement: For arbitrary independent indicator A of probability a, independent indicator P, fair independent selector Y, fresh sign bit x, and Boolean cores u,v,G on pairwise disjoint independent cubes, set B=P(1+x)/2 and F=(1-Y)G+Y[A u+(1-A)(B v+(1-B)G)]. The actual physical-query spectral erasure in bits satisfies B_x(F)<=(8+8a)Inf_x(F). In particular it is <=12Inf_x(F) for a<=1/2, and is zero for a=1. This holds after every compatible actual restriction leaving Y and x fresh. The same physical fallback G and both actual child entropy terminals are retained.
hypotheses: u,v,G Boolean on mutually disjoint cubes
A is an indicator independent of P,x,Y,u,v,G
P is an indicator independent of x,Y,u,v,G
the two appearances of G mean the SAME physical function; no independent copies
